blocks.content: Apart from those mentioned above the collections framework provides other methods to perform various different operations. Let's learn about those methods using the Practices below.

items: Practice: Reverse the order of elements
Practice: Swap the position of two elements in a collection
Practice: Fill every element of a collection with a specified value
Practice: Create a copy of elements from the specified source to destination
